rules.rationale: These exact files are CakeML repository-maintenance utilities for patching HOL scripts, linting build directories and generating/checking README summaries.

summary: Inspected 15+ files spanning compiler backend proofs (data_to_wordProof, backendProof, word_to_wordProof, reg_allocProof), Candle HOL semantics (holKernelProofScript, holModelConservativityScript, holSyntaxExtraScript), translator infrastructure (ml_monad_translatorScript, ml_monadBaseScript, ml_monad_translator_interfaceLib), GC proofs (copying_gcScript), type inference proofs (inferSoundScript), example verifications (array_searchProg, quicksortProg, fibProg, lpr_arrayFullProg, xlrup_arrayProg), and utility libraries (miscScript, preamble, cfAppLib, cfDivScript, ninetyOneScript, regexpMatchScript). All contain formal HOL4 content: Theory declarations, Datatype definitions, recursive Definitions, Theorems with tactical Proof/QED blocks, Overload declarations, and proof-supporting infrastructure. No files qualify for hard exclusion under FILTER-004.
